name: Raging Simulacrum (CR 3)
body:
RAGING SIMULACRUM
CR 3

XP 800
Male human barbarian (polar whaler) 4
CN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +4; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 8 (+4 Dex, –2 rage)
hp 51 (4d12+20)
Fort +9; Ref +5; Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee harpoon +9 (1d8+7/x3)
Ranged harpoon +8 (1d8+5)
Special Attacks I stab at thee, rage (19 rounds/day), rage powers (energy resistance [cold], scent)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 18, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 6, Cha 14
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 21
Feats Blind-Fight, Extra Rage, Point-Blank Shot
Skills Acrobatics +9 (+13 when jumping), Climb +10, Handle Animal +7, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (nature) +3, Perception +3, Survival +3, Swim +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping
Languages Common
SQ fast movement, man o’erboard

Base Statistics When not raging, the simulacrum’s statistics are AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 10; hp 43; Fort +7, Will -1; Melee harpoon +7 (1d8+4/x3); Ranged harpoon +8 (1d8+3/x3); Str 17, Con 16; CMB +7, CMD 21; Skills Climb +8, Swim +8.
